name: AI21 Labs
short: AI systems lab developing production enterprise LLMs (Jamba Mini, Jamba Large), with a $10/7-day evaluation credit (no card) and pay-as-you-go production billing.

plans.name: Developer Trial
plans.notes: Instant API key upon account signup with $10 in trial credits (valid 7 days, no credit card required). Usable locally via the AI21 REST API, Python SDK, or playground for Jamba Mini and Jamba Large.

plans.name: Production Pay-as-you-go
plans.notes: Activated by adding credit card details. Converts account to unmetered standard per-token billing with higher concurrency and enterprise tier options. Jamba Mini $0.2/$0.4 per 1M input/output tokens; Jamba Large $2/$8 per 1M input/output tokens.
